description: Structured research records for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 equipment and accessories. Acquisition routes are evidence-backed research fields and are not assumed to be current or guaranteed unless verified. Canonical identities are authoritative for downstream relationship endpoints; verification_status is evidence metadata only.

verification_policy.indexed: Identity discovered; acquisition or current behavior remains unresolved.
verification_policy.partially_verified: Identity and at least one meaningful acquisition/provenance detail are supported, but current route, restrictions, or version behavior remains unresolved.
verification_policy.verified: Identity, current acquisition, restrictions, and relevant behavior are reconciled against sufficient evidence.
